interpretation: This was a directed and non-exhaustive search. No exact match in the reviewed public-web result surface does not prove originality, authorship, clearance or universal absence of a prior source. It did not cover licensed databases, print-only works, deleted pages, translations, private documents, drafts or extensive paraphrase. Candidate factual sources were selected for later claim review; topical relevance or HTTP availability does not verify learner-facing claims, passage identity, authorship or rights.
